main_body: Autumn tree: large orange leaf canopy (rows ~1-33) on a brown trunk (rows ~32-44) with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Lighter orange leaf clumps on the upper canopy, about rows 2-9 in the middle column, then darker mid-orange and red-brown masses below
evidence: The canopy reads as a domed volume. Light orange clumps sit on top and the lit upper edges of each lobe are lighter. Dark red-brown shadow bands sit under the lobes and above the trunk. The trunk shows a front face with a root flare. There is no receding side face, and it is not a flat front elevation. This matches how the organic reference trees are built.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 orange steps (deep red-brown, dark orange, mid, light, highlight) plus a few yellow sparkle pixels. The trunk has 4 browns with a darker root base. Outlines are dark red-brown beside the leaves and dark brown beside the trunk, not black. Each lobe is shaded separately with dithered transitions. Leaf texture is smoother and blobbier than the reference's leaf clumps, so tile density is a bit lower, but there are no large flat fills. It would sit acceptably next to the reference.
